teaser: 143 notes in a day: how a pen on a printed release candidate became a record, decisions with provenance and a review hub, read by agents.
core_idea: A handwritten review of 19 printed pages of a book's release candidate became, in one day, 143 notes recorded word for word with their place and meaning, each page drawn three ways, 11 uncertain readings asked rather than guessed, four decisions recorded with the page and note that made them, themes led by the author's voice, a margin system with working QR codes, and a review hub where every note has an address: a handwritten review as traceable as a pull request.
